text: dude lmao wait if  its just data, then i could decode it into 2d ascii and view in a terminal  thats... wait i have the ability to use shaders in tuis through reactjit. oh damn that could be a really cool way to show 'decode it anywhere'; make that next
resolution: Added a decode-anywhere terminal proof: a pure ASCII adapter for LoadedScene/gamefile bytes, focused adapter tests, and a ReactJIT TUI cart with a shader strip that reads zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile (or HMSC_GAMEFILE) and renders the compiled city as an ASCII map. Verified byte tests and a 120x42 headless TUI snapshot.
